sentiment.summary: Bond yields spiked above 4.6% and oil rallied on Iran tensions, stoking inflation fears and dragging tech lower while the Dow barely held green.

insights.text: Yield spike rattles tech, oil stokes inflation fears. 10-year Treasury briefly topped 4.6% Monday as oil rallied on Iran tensions. Nasdaq led declines while Dow held green — defensive rotation underway. Stagflation risk is back on the table.

NVTS surges 21% on India GaN power IC partnership with Cyient Semiconductors. Launching India's first GaN power IC family is a major geopolitical tailwind. At $21.35 vs your $10 cost — up 113% — momentum is strong. ATH was $23.82 on May 11; watch for retest.

RKLB pulled back from $133 ATH but fundamentals remain rock-solid. Q1 revenue grew 63.5% YoY; Motiv Space acquisition expands mission capabilities. Deutsche Bank targets $120, Clear Street $150. At ~$121 vs your $62.04 cost — up ~95% — dips are opportunities.

TE rips 18% on Q1 earnings beat and major long-term supply deal. Narrower Q1 loss and higher net sales triggered institutional buying; ownership hit all-time highs. At $6.86 vs your $6.73 cost — this move finally puts you firmly in the green with upside ahead.

STX drops 7% on AI storage competition fears despite a strong Q3 earnings beat. At $800.74 vs your $448.98 cost — still up 78% — but the selloff signals real market concern over AI-driven storage disruption risk long-term. Tighten your mental stop here.

GOOG at $398 — just 1.9% above your $390.64 cost amid broad tech pressure. Rate fears are the near-term headwind, but Google's AI search monetization and Cloud growth keep the long-term thesis intact. No action needed; accumulate on deeper dips.

MSFT at $418 — just 2% above your $409.86 cost as rates weigh on tech valuations. Copilot and Azure AI revenue growth remain strong secular drivers. Rising yields are the key near-term risk. Core position — hold steady, no changes needed today.

MU drops 3% to $715 — down 9.5% from your $790.62 cost basis. Memory chip sentiment is weak amid macro uncertainty and AI capex spending concerns. You're underwater here. Wait for an HBM demand catalyst or earnings beat before adding more exposure.

SNDK at $1,408 — down 9.2% from your $1,550.95 cost and tracking MU weakness. NAND flash supply normalization is dragging storage names. No near-term catalyst visible. Hold; watch for NAND pricing recovery or enterprise SSD demand pickup before acting.

NBIS at $200 — up 52% from your $131.12 cost as European AI cloud demand surges. Strong positioning as a non-US GPU cloud alternative with Nvidia backing. Thesis firmly intact. Consider trimming a small portion to lock in gains and reduce single-name risk.

BTC dips to $76,860 on rate hike fears and whale profit-taking. Still 5.1% above your $73,135 cost basis. The $76,500 support level is key to watch. Any dovish Fed signal could spike this back above $80k fast — but macro headwinds keep near-term pressure on.

SATS rockets on SpaceX IPO proxy frenzy — $11B SpaceX exposure triggers retail surge. At $145.46 vs your $114.33 cost — up 27%. Fresh SpaceX IPO timeline news is the catalyst. High speculative momentum; can move violently both ways. Trail a tight stop.

BBAI at $4.02 — down 55% from your $9.02 cost with no clear near-term catalyst. BigBear.ai is struggling with contract execution and revenue visibility. A deep loss position. A major government contract win is the only realistic recovery trigger. High-risk hold.

OKLO at $62 — down 50% from your $125 cost as Q1 showed a $33.1M net loss. Regulatory progress and a new reactor partnership are encouraging but cash burn is real. Nuclear energy thesis is long-term valid; near-term pain is likely to persist. Patience required.
